open_issues.summary: Current Forever guides establish that equipped weapon DPS carries into both Cat and Bear and equipped weapon speed is irrelevant to form DPS. Runtime now consumes named weapon-DPS anchors directly. The remaining uncertainty is the target-server fixed Cat/Bear swing constants used to turn DPS into normal-weapon hits for percentage-weapon abilities.
evidence: current Wowhead/Icy Veins Forever Feral guides
open_issues.resolution: Probe target-server Cat/Bear swing timers; until then keep the explicit 1.0s/2.5s Classic-derived form-speed parameters visible.

open_issues.summary: Bear incoming-damage rage is now an explicit target-server profile parameter set. The current profile uses the pinned CMaNGOS Classic 1.12 RewardRage equation as a provenance-carrying proxy; Forever-specific hidden server values remain unverified.
open_issues.resolution: Replace the current profile parameters when target-server combat-log/server evidence establishes different values. The uncertainty is explicit and no longer a hidden universal mechanic assumption.

open_issues.summary: Druid out-of-combat health regeneration uses an explicit Classic-like proxy.
open_issues.resolution: Replace with Forever-specific recovery evidence when available.
